integrity: The proof is field-uniform and the bundled verifier independently checks finite instances. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts rank-one idempotent summands only. Other idempotent ranks can occur in small characteristic. Exhaustive checks cover prime fields of orders 2, 3, 5, and 7; arbitrary finite fields are covered by the proof. Literature search does not certify absolute novelty.
title: Rank-one nil-clean fibers of trace-one cubic companion matrices over finite fields
